description: Metadata for public Belfer Center pages on artificial intelligence, cyber, and emerging technology. Hosts are www.belfercenter.org and belfercenter.org. Each URL was confirmed with one bounded HTML GET. A challenge, captcha, login wall, robots disallow, donation page, or off-host redirect is not stored. Rows store title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. Publisher is Belfer Center. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. A sole restricted deed keeps its token. uk_ogl requires Open Government Licence. us_government_work requires a rights field. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
